## `neuro.object.isExtensible`

Static method on `Object`.

> Returns a value that indicates whether new properties can be added to an object.

## Signatures

```ts
isExtensible(input: { o: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.isExtensible` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
